layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, dense but readable data layers, heavy focus on athletic tension and clarity. Deep shadows replaced by strong border contrasts.
layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background text-text-primary pb-20 relative overflow-x-hidden
layout_and_spacing.navigation: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border z-50 flex justify-around items-center h-20 pb-safe

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-none border-b-4 border-orange-700 hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:border-b-2 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-[4px] transition-all h-14 flex items-center justify-center w-full text-xl
buttons.secondary: bg-surface_accent text-text_primary font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-none border-b-4 border-zinc-900 hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:border-b-2 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-[4px] transition-all h-14 flex items-center justify-center w-full text-xl

voting_cards.yes: flex-1 aspect-square bg-success/20 border-2 border-success rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-success/30 transition-colors
voting_cards.no: flex-1 aspect-square bg-danger/20 border-2 border-danger rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-danger/30 transition-colors
voting_cards.reserve: flex-1 aspect-square bg-warning/20 border-2 border-warning rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-warning/30 transition-colors

cards.player_card: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center gap-4
cards.stat_row: flex justify-between items-center py-3 border-b border-border last:border-0

pitch_view.container: relative w-full aspect-[2/3] bg-surface rounded-xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-border my-6
pitch_view.player_marker: absolute w-12 h-12 -ml-6 -mt-6 rounded-full border-2 border-primary bg-surface flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,69,0,0.5)] z-10 font-heading text-xl

inputs.text: w-full bg-background border border-border rounded-lg px-4 h-12 text-base focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary outline-none transition-all
inputs.label: text-sm font-bold text-text_secondary uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block

visual_enhancers.borders: Use strict 1px or 2px borders (border-border) for definition instead of soft drop shadows, fitting the 'Tactical Athletic' archetype.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only used for the bottom navigation bar and sticky header (bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-border).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (duotone or bold) or lucide-react with high contrast.
visual_enhancers.active_states: Interactive elements must lighten on hover and scale down slightly (scale-95) on active/press.

testing_rules.required_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, cards) MUST include 'data-testid' using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='vote-yes-button', data-testid='nav-home-tab').

club_logo.description: Orange bird representing the Dodo mascot, used as a placeholder for the club badge.

football_pitch.description: Overhead view of a football pitch, perfect for setting the background of the lineup visualization component.

hero_texture.description: Close up of a soccer goal net on a dark background. Great for a subtle background texture in the header or profile section.

player_1.description: Soccer player in uniform for avatar mockups.

player_2.description: Player ready to play, useful for leaderboard mockups.

player_3.description: Group of players, useful for match history thumbnails.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app as a responsive web app focused entirely on mobile viewport dimensions (max-width: md, centered on desktop).
Use standard React (Vite) + Tailwind + Shadcn components (customized to match the tactical dark theme).
Implement a fixed bottom navigation bar with 4 tabs: Home, Squad, Matches, Profile.
For typography, import Bebas Neue (for headings) and Manrope (for body) via Google Fonts.
Lineup Visualization: Use the provided 'football_pitch' image as a background in a relative container. Map players using absolute positioning based on generic coordinates for a 5-a-side formation.
Voting UI: Use large touch-friendly areas (Yes = green, No = red, Reserve = amber). These should dominate the 'Home' or 'Upcoming Match' screen.
Avoid using Shadcn's default rounded cards. Override them with sharper edges (rounded-xl at most) and distinct borders (border-border).
Ensure the app functions without requiring any external native dependencies since it will be built with React/Tailwind on the web.
Apply `data-testid` to all crucial elements for the testing agent.
